verses.1: So, brothers, I was not able to speak to you as spiritual beings, but rather as fleshly beings, as children in Christ.
verses.2: I have asked you for milk; not food, for you are unable to eat anything else. But you still cannot do that yet.
verses.3: After all, you’re still fleshly beings. For where there is greed and envy among you, aren’t you also fleshly in your actions?
verses.4: For when someone says, “I am Paul,” another might say, “I am Apollos. Aren’t I also a human being?”
verses.5: What is Apollos then? What is Paul? It’s the ministers who believed in him, and to each of them he gave something as a gift from the Lord.
verses.6: I was born, Apollonius asked for more, but the god granted it.
verses.7: So, neither the one who plants is anything at all, nor is the one who drinks. Instead, he is a god who grows things.
verses.8: And those who plant and drink also belong to this category. Each of them receives their own reward according to their own efforts.
verses.9: For we are indeed partners with God; we are indeed His “works” and His “houses”.
verses.10: By the will of God, I was given the task of building a wise foundation as an architect. But others will continue to build upon that foundation. Let each of them see how they continue to build upon it.
verses.11: For no one else can truly become a god in place of the one who is already divine—that is, Jesus Christ.
verses.12: But if anyone were to build a structure on the foundation using gold, silver, precious stones, wood, plaster, and other materials,
verses.13: Each person’s work will be revealed on that day. It will be known that each person’s work is tested by the fire.
verses.14: If someone completes the work that has been built, they will be paid accordingly.
verses.15: If someone tries to complete this work, they will be punished; but he himself will be saved, just as if it were through fire.
verses.16: Don’t you know that you are also a part of God, and that the spirit of God resides within you?
verses.17: If anyone desecrates the statue of the God, then the God will desecrate that person as well. For the statue of the God is sacred; after all, you are also sacred.
verses.18: Do not deceive yourself. If someone seems wise among you during this time of year, then be foolish, so that he may become wise.
verses.19: For the wisdom of this world is foolish in the eyes of God. It is written, “He who acts with wisdom among those who are wise.”
verses.20: And once again: The Lord sees that the thoughts of the wise are futile.
verses.21: So that no one may boast about me among people. For everything belongs to you.
verses.22: Whether it’s Paul, Apollos, Cephas, or anyone else, whether it’s life or death, whether it’s the present or the future, everything belongs to you.
verses.23: And you, as Christ’s people, who are also Christ’s followers.
